product.name: Toxic Teddies: Arrow Escape
product.architecture: Vite JavaScript SVG bundled through Capacitor 8

designSystem.source: Owner-supplied Toxic Teddies Design System board

typography.runtimeDisplayPolicy: Use the approved illustrated Toxic Teddies logo where exact branding is required because no custom Toxic Head font file is bundled.

notDefinedByDesignSystem: exact arrow counts for future levels
implementation status of stars times difficulty selectors or achievements

runtimeDesignImplementation.appShell: Grime 900 and Ink 900 dark distressed surfaces
runtimeDesignImplementation.boardPolicy: The owner-approved environment sits behind the complete game view while the central board remains quiet and readable.
runtimeDesignImplementation.modalPolicy: Parchment modal cards with dark text and toxic primary actions
runtimeDesignImplementation.retiredTheme: Cream page background with translucent white cards

loadingScreen.artwork: Owner-approved Toxic Teddies Arrow Escape artwork with Toxic Toby in a radioactive laboratory
loadingScreen.delivery: Real preloaded WebP file materialized into public assets and copied unchanged by Vite

gameplayBackdrops.presentation: The manifest-selected environment is mirrored behind the complete game view and the old square duplicate is suppressed.

brandAssetPipeline.buildRule: Essential first-paint artwork must be a real file referenced directly from HTML and must not depend on JavaScript execution.
brandAssetPipeline.viteRule: Place exact-name static assets under public so Vite copies them unchanged into dist.
brandAssetPipeline.nativeRule: Capacitor sync copies the verified dist assets into Android and iOS.
brandAssetPipeline.offlineRule: The service worker caches the same runtime paths.
